{{Weapon infobox | type = Sword | level = 80 | salvage = none | rarity = Legendary | prefix = selectable | uslot = Superior Sigil of Air | skin = Bolt (skin); Zap (skin); Crystalline Blade (skin); Zap Experiment (skin) | bound = account use | id = 30699 | gallery2 = Bolt stowed.jpg | gallery2-text = Stowed. | gallery3 = Bolt footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Lightning footfalls. }} [[Bolt]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] [[sword]] crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|Interwoven with an impression of a [[dragon]] whose name [[Tyria]] has yet to learn, Bolt is imbued with the strength of a storm–swelling inside like a thunderous inferno, eager to aid its wielder in combat.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Zap | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Bolt | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[Bolt]] is a golden sword with four dragons twisting up the blade. ;Aura * While drawn, the user is surrounded by white, blue, and purple lightning, and white lightning periodically strikes the ground around the user. ;Draw/Stow sounds * A long lightning sound is heard when drawing Bolt. While drawn, the weapon is surrounded by lightning. * A short lightning sound is heard when stowing Bolt. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind charred ground footprints with electrical sparks. ;Kill animations * Bolt's [[Damage type]] is lightning. Enemies killed while wielding Bolt will display electrocuted death animations. ;Skill effects * Default class weapon trails are replaced with lightning trails. * Lightning sounds are heard while attacking. * Ranged skills will throw [[Bolt]] instead of the default projectile. This effect changes the following skills: ** {{g}} [[Guardian]]: [[Zealot's Defense]]. *** {{dragonhunter}} [[Dragonhunter]]: [[Spear of Justice]]. ** {{en}} [[Engineer]]: [[Grenade Barrage]]. *** {{holosmith}} [[Holosmith]]: [[Blade Burst]], [[Particle Accelerator]], [[Refraction Cutter]]. ** {{weaver}} [[Weaver]]: [[Natural Frenzy]] and [[Shearing Edge]]. ** {{m}} [[Mesmer]]: [[Counter Blade]]. Clones wielding Bolt in the main hand will inherit all visual and audio effects. Clones wielding Bolt in the off hand will inherit the drawing sounds. ** {{ranger}} [[Ranger]]: [[Throw Dirt]] (downed skill). *** {{Soulbeast}} [[Soulbeast]]: any projectile from Soulbeast pet skills such as [[Narcotic Spores (soulbeast)|Narcotic Spores]]. ** {{re}} [[Revenant]]: [[Essence Sap]] (downed skill). *** {{renegade}} [[Renegade]]: [[Citadel Bombardment]]. ** {{t}} [[Thief]]: [[Trail of Knives]] (downed skill) and projectiles acquired through [[Steal]]. ** {{warrior}} [[Warrior]]: [[Impale]] and [[Throw Rock]] (downed skill). *** {{berserker}} [[Berserker]]: [[Flaming Flurry]]. === Gallery === File:Bolt concept art.jpg|Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]]. File:Bolt Aura.jpg|Aura. File:Bolt swing.jpg|Electric effect on weapon swing. File:Bolt trail weaver.jpg|Electric trail on Weaver. File:Bolt projectile.jpg|Projectile.
